title: Agreed hint response (documents the runtime contract; no schema library is used)

explanation.description: Nonempty after trimming; at most 160 JavaScript (UTF-16) string units measured on the original string. Accepted text is returned unchanged.

x-domain-rule: action.direction must be in the allowed list derived by the rule helper for the current state (north/east/south/west order).
x-extra-field-policy: Additional fields are accepted but omitted from the public hint.
x-fallback: First permitted action with explanation 'A permitted next move.', or hint null when no action is permitted (no client call).
